recent_deploys.message: service-discovery: hotfix set require_healthy=false for internal-metrics-collector

ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy SHA c7f3a91 introduced a misconfiguration in service-discovery/config/registry.yaml that set require_healthy=true for the internal-metrics-collector client. This client was subsequently scaled to 0 replicas for a maintenance window (SHA f20cd53). When the service-discovery refresh cycle failed to reach internal-metrics-collector and the require_healthy gate triggered, the registry aborted its refresh and cleared all cached upstream endpoint data, dropping all 14 registered services from the registry simultaneously. Every dependent service (frontend, checkout-service, payment-service, etc.) then received empty upstream lists and began returning HTTP 503 errors globally.
ground_truth_remediation: Immediately apply a config hotfix to set require_healthy=false for internal-metrics-collector in service-discovery/config/registry.yaml (as done in SHA d9b2e44) and trigger a forced registry refresh. Long-term: enforce policy that only genuinely critical data-plane services can have require_healthy=true, and add a CI/CD validation step that rejects require_healthy=true on auxiliary/monitoring clients. Additionally, decouple registry refresh failure modes so that an unhealthy optional client never clears the existing healthy upstream cache.
